The '''Constabulary''' was located in [[Tasariq City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. It served as the command center and jail for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-run [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]]. A [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|troopers]] and two companies of [[Tasariq Rangers]] were stationed at the Constabulary.<ref name="J15" />
